phase2_completed_steps.name: Thrust curve
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/thrust_curve.py: lru_cache loader + np.interp, zero after last point; removed T_BURN hack entirely from forces.py. Params gains motor_curve (default "", Phase-1-preserving). Added burnout event to both integrators (Result.events["burnout"]), including a fix for a real scipy solve_ivp gotcha (an always-zero event function is spuriously classified as both rising and falling under <=/>= comparisons; fixed with a 1e-9 N epsilon shift on the RK45 path). data/motors/placeholder.csv: illustrative solid-motor-shaped curve (spike/settle/sustain/tail-off), stated impulse 162.75 N*s verified by np.trapezoid. 47/47 tests passing. Intentionally not a bit-for-bit regression vs Step 13 (real thrust curve replacing a fake constant-thrust rectangle is the point).

phase2_completed_steps.name: Pressure correction to thrust
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/thrust_curve.py: T(t,h) = T_ref(t) + A_e*(p_ref - p_amb), p_amb from atmosphere.air_state. Params gains A_e (default 0.0) and p_ref (default 101325.0). Guarded to apply only while T_ref(t) > 0 to avoid manufacturing thrust from ambient pressure alone post-burnout/pre-ignition. A_e=0.0 default reproduces Step 14 bit-for-bit, confirmed via run.py (identical printed summary). 50/50 tests passing (3 new).

phase2_completed_steps.name: Sounding data format, loader, altitude interpolation
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/soundings.py (new): Sounding NamedTuple (station/lat/lon/elev/time_utc/h/p/T/u/v, wind converted from wdir/wspd to ENU u/v at load time); load_case(case) lru_cache'd loader globbing data/soundings/<case>/*.csv; interp_altitude(sounding,h) -> SoundingState(p,T,rho,a,mu,u,v) tier-2 seam (T linear, p linear-in-ln, u/v linear, rho/a/mu derived reusing atmosphere.py's constants). Below-range: local lapse rate from the sounding's own first two points. Above-range: ISA-shaped profile re-anchored at the sounding's top point for continuity. No physics wired into atmosphere.py/wind.py yet (Steps 18/22). Worked example: data/soundings/example/LKPR_202605011200.csv. 62/62 tests passing (12 new), including the roadmap's stated 0.5%-vs-ISA check.

phase2_completed_steps.name: Atmosphere tier 2: single-station sounding data

Params gains sounding_case (default ""). Default atmosphere_model="isa" unchanged. 66/66 tests passing (4 new): ISA-derived synthetic case matches isa tier to ~0.05%; full trajectory with synthetic case matches isa run to ~0.01-0.02%; real LKPR example (elevation 380m) is measurably less dense than ISA at that altitude (~0.71% lower), producing a higher apogee (~0.47%) and shorter impact time (~0.98%) as expected from less drag -- checked as a directional assertion, not just inequality.

phase2_completed_steps.name: Horizontal interpolation core: tangent-plane projection and IDW
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/soundings.py gains tier-3 horizontal combination (pure infra, not wired into atmosphere.py/wind.py yet): _resample_case (per-station grid resampling via interp_altitude, cached on (case,grid_top_m,grid_step_m)), project_latlon (equirectangular projection), interp_field_at/interp_field (IDW w_i~1/(d_i^2+eps^2) or rbf via scipy.interpolate.RBFInterpolator, combined then run back through interp_altitude). Params gains horizontal_interp/grid_top_m/grid_step_m/idw_epsilon_m. 72/72 tests passing (6 new): single-station exact match, station's-own-coordinates dominated-but-not-identical (exact analytic bound, not loose tolerance), two-identical-stations exact everywhere, rocket-ground-position wrapper matches explicit-point seam, rbf smoke test, projected-vs-haversine <0.1% with a documented caveat that pure-diagonal offsets pushed to the full 100km can exceed that bound (expected property of the equirectangular approximation itself, not a bug).

phase2_completed_steps.name: Atmosphere tier 3: multi-station spatially interpolated data
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/atmosphere.py gains _field_air_state (tier 3, delegates to soundings.interp_field(p.sounding_case,y,h_msl,p) from Step 19, repackages into AirState). First atmosphere model depending on y[X], not just y[Z]. No new Params fields. New example data/soundings/field_example/: FLDA (T0=293.15K/p0=102000Pa) and FLDB (T0=288.15K/p0=99000Pa), ~37km due east of each other (purely cardinal, per Step 19's own projection-accuracy note). 74/74 tests passing (2 new): single-station case reproduces sounding tier exactly through full air_state seam; two-station ground-track sweep shows density decreasing monotonically from FLDA to FLDB, the correct direction given FLDA is actually denser at every shared altitude (verified from real station numbers, not asserted blindly).

phase2_completed_steps.name: Wind tier 1: analytic shear profile
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/wind.py (new): wind_inertial dispatches on wind_model (none=zeros default, analytic=power-law shear W(h)=wind_ref_ms*(max(h,h_ref)/h_ref)^shear_exp, AGL). Meteorological wdir-azimuth projection onto flight plane; cross-plane component discarded via wind_horizontal_enu (exposed for Phase 3). Deterministic gusts: frozen sum of 8 sinusoids seeded via gust_seed, cached; gust_sigma=0.0 skips RNG entirely. flow._wind_inertial now delegates here. Params gains wind_model/wind_ref_ms/wind_dir_deg/wind_ref_h_m/wind_shear_exp/gust_sigma/gust_seed. 81/81 tests passing (7 new): none reproduces pre-Step-21 stub bit-for-bit; pure headwind raises V by exactly wind speed; four cardinal directions give derived signs; headwind/tailwind bracket still-air apogee correctly (needed inclined launch); gust determinism and gust_sigma=0 exactness. Flagged (not a bug): shared test-module aero coefficients (C_N_alpha/C_m_alpha/l1) are pitch-unstable once alpha!=0 is engaged -- relevant for Step 25.

phase2_completed_steps.name: Wind tier 2: single-station sounding data
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/wind.py gains _sounding_wind (tier 2, loads p.sounding_case via soundings.load_case, first station only, interp_altitude for ENU u/v at MSL altitude, not AGL). Projects ENU onto flight plane via w_along=u*sin(A)+v*cos(A), w_cross=u*cos(A)-v*sin(A) -- derived from scratch and verified algebraically consistent with tier 1's wdir-based formula. No new format/loader/Params field. 86/86 tests passing (6 new): constant-wind sounding matches analytic tier at shear_exp=0; synthetic veering profile matches -W*cos(wdir) exactly; real LKPR example case wind veers 210->265deg from 380m to 10000m, confirmed against hand-computed values; MSL convention confirmed.

phase2_completed_steps.name: Wind tier 3: multi-station spatially interpolated data
phase2_completed_steps.note: sim/wind.py gains _field_wind (tier 3, delegates to soundings.interp_field from Step 19, reuses tier 2's ENU projection unchanged). 6 executable lines, matching roadmap's own 'handful of lines' prediction. No new Params fields. Closes out all three wind tiers. 88/88 tests passing (2 new): single-station case reproduces sounding tier exactly; new synthetic two-station opposing-wind case (0/180deg, N-S) shows along-plane wind increasing strictly monotonically across an 11-point sweep, crossing zero exactly once.

flagged_issues_step19.issue: equirectangular tangent-plane projection's error vs great-circle grows with diagonal (non-cardinal) displacement and can exceed 0.1% for diagonal offsets approaching 100km at mid-latitudes, even though it stays under cardinal-direction offsets at any distance and moderate diagonals (~35km). This is an expected property of the projection architecture.md SS17 itself specifies, not a bug. Worth remembering when picking station positions for Step 20/23 field-tier test fixtures -- avoid relying on exact <0.1% distance claims for far diagonal placements.
